scope: EU organic frozen minced beef and chicken suppliers
method: Official-site-first web research; Gemini cloud browser tested as supplementary discovery tool
gemini_result: Broad 27-country request did not return usable results; no supplier was accepted from Gemini alone.

sources_checked.name: ActiMeat organic cooked minced beef
sources_checked.reason: Strong pallet and price evidence, but certificate body/number still needs independent verification; product is cooked and must be separated from raw-minced statistics.

sources_checked.name: Alcass / Amica Natura organic frozen ground beef
sources_checked.reason: Official organic frozen food-service product evidence; no public multi-pallet MOQ or certificate number found.

sources_checked.name: WestfalenLand / WestFood-IceHouse
sources_checked.reason: Industrial business-to-business processor with Bio minced meat and frozen range; exact organic frozen minced block SKU, pallet conditions and certificate still need verification.

sources_checked.name: Biofino
sources_checked.reason: Official organic poultry evidence found, but no qualifying pure frozen minced chicken bulk product was located; available poultry mince evidence concerns a turkey/chicken mix and lacks pallet/MOQ proof.

sources_checked.name: Bauckhof / Bio-Hoflieferant
sources_checked.reason: Pure frozen organic chicken mince and DE-ÖKO-022 evidence are visible, but the offer is consumer-sized 2 x 250 g packaging with no industrial or pallet evidence.

sources_checked.name: Bio Rind & Fleisch EZG GmbH
sources_checked.reason: Official site confirms organic beef and wholesale activity, but no frozen minced beef product evidence was found on the public pages.

next_actions: Search independent EU organic certification registries for the two strongest leads.
Locate product catalogues/specifications for bulk or pallet packaging.
Expand country-by-country searches using local-language query matrix.
Add only independently verified products to price and trend aggregates.
